# MKS’ Atotech to showcase future-ready corrosion protection and decorative finishing technologies at EBRATS 2026


**Berlin, August 25, 2026 –** MKS’ Atotech, a leading surface finishing brand within the Materials Solutions Division of MKS, will participate in EBRATS 2026 (Exposição Brasileira de Tratamentos de Superfície), taking place from September 9-12 at the São Paulo Expo Exhibition & Convention Center in São Paulo, Brazil.


As Latin America’s premier event for the surface finishing industry, EBRATS brings together manufacturers, suppliers, and industry experts to explore the latest technologies, market trends, and innovations shaping the future of surface treatment.


At EBRATS 2026, MKS’ Atotech will present its theme, “Future-ready surface finishing for Brazil and Latin America: Sustainable chemistry. Smarter processes. Efficient production.” Visitors will discover technologies that help manufacturers improve product performance, increase process efficiency, and prepare for evolving sustainability and regulatory requirements.


As a leading provider of surface finishing solutions, MKS’ Atotech combines chemistry, equipment, process expertise, and local technical support to help customers reduce environmental impact while maintaining the high quality and reliability required across automotive, industrial, fastener, and consumer applications.


A key focus will be high-performance corrosion protection with a lower environmental footprint. MKS’ Atotech will showcase zinc nickel and zinc flake technologies designed for demanding applications requiring excellent corrosion resistance, process stability, and long-term durability. The company will also highlight innovations that support improved process efficiency, reduced waste, lower chemistry consumption, and a transition toward non-PFAS coating solutions.


**Highlights include:**


- Zinc nickel technologies for high-performance corrosion protection and process stability
- Non-PFAS zinc flake solutions that support evolving regulatory requirements
- Process innovations that help increase productivity and reduce total cost of ownership


MKS’ Atotech will also feature its **TriChrome®** portfolio of Cr(VI)-free decorative chrome technologies, delivering premium aesthetics, versatile design possibilities, and durable surface performance for a wide range of decorative applications.


**Our portfolio** **h** **ighlights include:**


- Premium bright and darker decorative finishes
- Design flexibility for metal substrates and plating on plastics
- Applications for automotive, sanitary, consumer, and lifestyle products


Visit MKS’ Atotech at **booth 570** to learn how advanced corrosion protection and decorative finishing technologies can help support more efficient and sustainable production.


**Event:** EBRATS 2026
**Date:** September 9–12, 2026
**Booth:** 570
**Venue:** São Paulo Expo Exhibition & Convention Center, São Paulo, Brazil


For more information, please visit:[https://www.ebrats.com.br/](https://www.ebrats.com.br/)
